title: Aura API response
description: The JSON one Aura table expects from its endpoint. `header` describes the columns and is required; `items` carries the row data; `body` configures how individual columns render; `meta` / `links` drive the pagination bar. Keys beyond these are ignored.

header.description: Column definitions. Required — without it there is no table to render.

footer.description: Footer rows, built from the same cells as the header.

items.description: The rows. Each entry is one row object, read by the `field` / `key` names the header declares; nested values are reachable with dotted field names. Values are rendered as they arrive — no schema is imposed on them.

badgeConfig.description: Bootstrap badge cell. Label and colour resolve in one of three modes: static (`value` / `field` with a fixed `variant`), value → config `mapping`, or boolean `trueValue` / `falseValue`. In counter mode `prefix` / `suffix`, `maxValue` (overflow renders `{maxValue}{suffix}`) and `showZero` apply.

field.description: Item field whose value drives the badge.

value.description: Fixed label text, used instead of `field`.

mapping.description: Value → badge config lookup, keyed by the resolved value.

trueValue.description: Badge config used when the value is truthy.

falseValue.description: Badge config used when the value is falsy.

showZero.description: Render the badge when the numeric value is 0. Defaults to `true`.

maxValue.description: Cap on the displayed number; above it the badge renders `{maxValue}{suffix}`.

prefix.description: Text prepended to the label, e.g. `#`.

icon.description: Key into the host app’s `icons` config registry, rendered as an `<i>` glyph.

iconPosition.description: Icon placement relative to the label.

color.description: Text colour of the rendered content.

background.description: Background colour behind the rendered content.

fontSize.description: Font size of the rendered content.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the rendered content.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the rendered content.

text.description: Bootstrap text utility class on the rendered content.

capitalize.description: Capitalise the first letter of the rendered text.

slice.description: Truncate the rendered text to this many characters.

number.description: Format the value as a number.

currency.description: Format the value as currency, using the host app’s `currencyCode` config.

date.description: Format the value as a date.

phone.description: Format the value as a phone number.

unit.description: Unit appended to the formatted value.

padStart.description: Pad the rendered text to this length on the left, with `chars`.

padEnd.description: Pad the rendered text to this length on the right, with `chars`.

class.description: CSS classes on the rendered element.

style.description: Inline CSS on the rendered element.

cellRules.description: Conditional styling for the `<td>` around the badge.

key.description: Item field the `if` conditions read, and the field substituted into `{key}` placeholders in `route`. Defaults to the column key.

if.description: Condition branches; the first matching one is merged over this config.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

allOf.title: One of `field`, `value`, `mapping`, `trueValue` or `falseValue` is required — unless `if` or `else` branches are given

badgeMappingEntry.description: One badge configuration — used as a `mapping` entry and as `trueValue` / `falseValue`.

columnConfigs.description: Per-column renderers, keyed by the header cell’s `key`. An entry whose `type` is not one of the supported renderers is reported as a warning and skipped — the rest of the body still renders.

columnStyles.description: CSS classes per column, keyed by the header cell’s `key`. Passed through to the cell unvalidated.

rowRules.description: Conditional styling for whole rows: the base formatting merged with the `if` / `else` branches, evaluated per row.

buttonConfig.description: Button cell. The label comes from `field`, `value` or a `mapping` entry; with `route` the button acts as a link.

field.description: Item field whose value becomes the button label.

value.description: Fixed button label, used instead of `field`.

route.description: URL template; `{key}` placeholders are filled from the row, dots become slashes, and the host app’s `siteName` is prepended.

variant.description: Key into the host app’s `variants` config registry, or a Bootstrap colour name.

icon.description: Key into the host app’s `icons` config registry, rendered as an `<i>` glyph.

iconPosition.description: Icon placement relative to the label.

color.description: Text colour of the rendered content.

background.description: Background colour behind the rendered content.

fontSize.description: Font size of the rendered content.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the rendered content.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the rendered content.

text.description: Bootstrap text utility class on the rendered content.

capitalize.description: Capitalise the first letter of the rendered text.

slice.description: Truncate the rendered text to this many characters.

number.description: Format the value as a number.

currency.description: Format the value as currency, using the host app’s `currencyCode` config.

date.description: Format the value as a date.

phone.description: Format the value as a phone number.

unit.description: Unit appended to the formatted value.

padStart.description: Pad the rendered text to this length on the left, with `chars`.

padEnd.description: Pad the rendered text to this length on the right, with `chars`.

class.description: CSS classes on the rendered element.

style.description: Inline CSS on the rendered element.

cellRules.description: Conditional styling for the `<td>` around the button.

mapping.description: Value → button config lookup (variant, size, disabled, icon …), selected by `field`.

key.description: Item field the `if` conditions read, and the field substituted into `{key}` placeholders in `route`. Defaults to the column key.

if.description: Condition branches; the first matching one is merged over this config.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

allOf.title: One of `field`, `value`, `route`, `icon` or `mapping` is required — unless `if` or `else` branches are given

buttonMappingEntry.description: One entry of the `mapping` lookup, keyed by the field value.

cellFormattingOptions.description: Visual options applied to the `<td>` element itself.

class.description: Extra CSS classes on the cell.

cellRules.description: Conditional cell styling: the base `cellFormattingOptions` merged with the `if` / `else` branches, whose entries carry `cellFormattingOptions` keys. The same shape drives `body.rowRules` for whole rows.

cellType.description: Cell type marker on a header cell. Formatting types (`number`, `currency`, `date`, `datetime`, `phone`, `time`) format the value; the rest name a `body.columnConfigs` renderer.

color.description: Bootstrap theme colour name, or a CSS colour (`#fff`, `#ffffff`, `rgb(…)`, `rgba(…)`, or a CSS colour keyword). Used for both `color` and `background`.

colspan.description: Number of columns the cell spans (1–50).

columnConfig.description: One column renderer. `type` selects which renderer — and which config shape — applies.

conditionalConfig.description: Conditional rendering. `key` names the item field the conditions read; each `if` branch that matches is merged over the base config, and `else` applies when none matched.

key.description: Item field the conditions are evaluated against. Defaults to the column key when omitted.

else.description: Config applied when no `if` branch matched.

conditionalRule.description: One branch of an `if` array. Exactly one operator key decides whether the branch matches — the first recognised operator key wins, in object key order. Every remaining key is the configuration applied when it matches (its shape is the shape of the config the rule sits in).

ne.description: Not equal to the given value.

gte.description: Greater than or equal to the given value.

lte.description: Less than or equal to the given value.

between.description: Inside the inclusive `[min, max]` range — a two-element array.

notIn.description: Not contained by the given array.

regex.description: Matches the given regular expression (source string).

empty.description: Value is empty (`null`, empty string, `[]`, `{}`) — pass `true`.

contentUnit.description: Free-text unit appended to the formatted value (max 50 chars), e.g. `kg`, `%`.

cssClass.description: CSS class names: one string (max 500 chars) or an array of class names (max 50 items, 100 chars each). HTML-sanitised on arrival.

cssSize.description: CSS length: `'100px'`, `'50%'`, `'2.5rem'` or `'auto'`. Used for both `width` and `height`.

customConfig.description: Escape hatch. `renderer` and `callback` name functions in the host app’s function registry — the response carries the name only, never code. `template` is an interpolated string. With none of them, the cell falls back to rendering `field` / `fields` / `value`.

fields.description: Several item fields passed to the renderer.

renderer.description: Name of a function in the host app’s function registry that returns the rendered node.

callback.description: Name of a function in the host app’s function registry that returns the text to render.

template.description: Template string; `{placeholder}` tokens are filled from the row and from `params`.

params.description: Extra values available to `template` and to the registered functions.

mapping.description: Value → template-parameter lookup, keyed by the resolved value.

color.description: Text colour of the rendered content.

background.description: Background colour behind the rendered content.

fontSize.description: Font size of the rendered content.

fontWeight.description: Font weight of the rendered content.

lineHeight.description: Line height of the rendered content.

text.description: Bootstrap text utility class on the rendered content.

capitalize.description: Capitalise the first letter of the rendered text.

date.description: Format the value as a date.

phone.description: Format the value as a phone number.

unit.description: Unit appended to the formatted value.

padEnd.description: Pad the rendered text to this length on the right, with `chars`.

style.description: Inline CSS on the rendered element.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

allOf.title: One of `renderer`, `callback`, `template`, `field`, `fields` or `value` is required — unless `if` or `else` branches are given

customTemplateParams.description: Template parameters for one `mapping` entry: `name: value` pairs substituted into `template`.

dataAttributeValue.description: Value of a `data-*` attribute (max 1000 chars). HTML-sanitised on arrival.

fields.description: Field names for a multi-field column (at least one, max 100 chars each). Mutually exclusive with `field`; requires an explicit `key`.

filterElements.description: Options offered by the column filter: either an array of strings/numbers, or an object of `value: label` pairs. When omitted, Aura derives the options from the loaded rows.

flag.description: Boolean switch. `null` is accepted and read as `false`.

fontSize.description: CSS font-size: a `px`/`rem`/`em`/`%` length, or a keyword (`small`, `large`, `x-large`, …).

fontWeight.description: CSS font-weight: a multiple of 100 between 100 and 900 (number or string), or `normal` / `bold` / `lighter` / `bolder`.

rows.description: Footer rows, top to bottom. At least one row is required.

sticky.description: Keep the footer fixed to the bottom of the scroll container.

rows.description: Header rows, top to bottom. At least one row is required; several rows build a grouped header.

headerCell.description: One header cell — the definition of a column. A *data cell* names its source with `field` or `fields`; a *grouping cell* has neither and spans several columns with `colspan` > 1. Unknown keys are dropped, except `data-*` attributes, which are kept and rendered onto the `<th>`.

content.description: Column heading text. Required on every cell; `null` renders an empty heading.

key.description: Unique column identifier — the key `body.columnConfigs` entries are looked up by, and the key used in session persistence. Defaults to `field` when only `field` is given; required when `fields` is used.

field.description: Item field this column reads. Mutually exclusive with `fields`. Required on data cells (a grouping cell — one with `colspan` > 1 and no field — may omit it).

label.description: Alternative heading text, kept for backwards compatibility.

resizable.description: Allow the user to drag the column width.

sortable.description: Offer sorting on this column. Sorting is server-side: the field lands in the request’s `sortable` array.

searchable.description: Offer the per-column search input. Server-side: the field lands in the request’s `searchable` array.

filterable.description: Offer the per-column filter dropdown. Server-side: the field lands in the request’s `filterable` array.

selectable.description: Render row-selection checkboxes in this column. The chosen ids are sent as `selected`.

between.description: Offer a range (min–max) search instead of a term search. Sends `min` / `max` in the request’s `searchable` entry.

number.description: Format the column’s values as numbers.

currency.description: Format the column’s values as currency, using the host app’s `currencyCode` config.

unit.description: Format the column’s values with `Intl.NumberFormat` unit style.

date.description: Format the column’s values as dates.

datetime.description: Format the column’s values as date + time.

phone.description: Format the column’s values as phone numbers.

time.description: Read the column’s values as seconds and render them as `HH:mm:ss`. Integers only; negatives allowed.

capitalize.description: Capitalise the first letter of the rendered values.

object.description: Treat the column’s values as objects.

raw.description: Render the column’s values as raw HTML. Sanitised before rendering.

class.description: CSS classes on the heading cell.

style.description: Inline CSS on the heading cell.

allOf.title: field and fields are mutually exclusive
a cell without field/fields must be a grouping cell

headerRow.description: One header row. Keys other than `cells` are dropped.

cells.description: Cells of the row, left to right. At least one is required.

sticky.description: Keep the header fixed to the top of the scroll container.

searchableItems.description: Fields the toolbar’s global search covers. Every entry must match the `field` of some header cell — an unknown field is a validation error.

iconConfig.description: Icon cell. `icon` and `variant` / `color` are registry keys — the preprocessor resolves them against the host app’s `icons` and `variants` config into the `class` array before rendering. Given a `route`, the glyph is wrapped in a link.

icon.description: Key into the host app’s `icons` config registry; resolved into CSS classes.

class.description: CSS classes on the `<i>` element. Accepted directly instead of `icon`.

variant.description: Key into the host app’s `variants` config registry, or a Bootstrap colour name; resolved into a `text-{colour}` class. CSS colour syntax is rejected here.

color.description: Alternative to `variant`, resolved the same way.

route.description: URL template; `{key}` placeholders are filled from the row, dots become slashes, and the host app’s `siteName` is prepended.

mapping.description: Value → icon config lookup, applied after the `if` / `else` branches are flattened.

cellRules.description: Conditional styling for the `<td>` around the icon.

key.description: Item field the `if` conditions read, and the field substituted into `{key}` placeholders in `route`. Defaults to the column key.

if.description: Condition branches; the first matching one is merged over this config.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

allOf.title: One of `icon`, `class` or `mapping` is required — unless `if` or `else` branches are given

iconMappingEntry.description: One entry of the `mapping` lookup, keyed by the field value.

lineHeight.description: CSS line-height: a positive number, a `px`/`em`/`rem`/`%` length, or `normal`.

linkConfig.description: Anchor cell. The text comes from `field` (per row), `value` (fixed) or a `mapping` entry; the URL from `route`.

field.description: Item field whose value becomes the link text.

value.description: Fixed link text, used instead of `field`.

route.description: URL template; `{key}` placeholders are filled from the row, dots become slashes, and the host app’s `siteName` is prepended.

date.description: Format the value as a date.

phone.description: Format the value as a phone number.

unit.description: Unit appended to the formatted value.

style.description: Inline CSS on the rendered element.

mapping.description: Value → link config lookup (variant, colour, route, target …), selected by `field`.

cellRules.description: Conditional styling for the `<td>` around the link.

key.description: Item field the `if` conditions read, and the field substituted into `{key}` placeholders in `route`. Defaults to the column key.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

allOf.title: One of `field`, `value`, `route` or `mapping` is required — unless `if` or `else` branches are given

linkMappingEntry.description: One entry of the `mapping` lookup, keyed by the field value.

links.description: Page URLs. Informational — Aura paginates by sending `page` in the request.

prev.description: URL of the previous page; `null` on the first page.

next.description: URL of the next page; `null` on the last page.

meta.description: Pagination state of the current page.

from.description: Index of the first item on the page; `null` on an empty page.

path.description: Base URL of the paginated resource.

per_page.description: Items per page — the value the request sent as `paginate`.

to.description: Index of the last item on the page; `null` on an empty page.

total.description: Total number of items across all pages.

modalConfig.description: Modal trigger cell. `id` names the modal to open; the trigger is either the nested `content` config, or the `icon` / `button` shorthand the preprocessor expands into one. `destroyModal` is the built-in delete-confirmation modal.

id.description: Identifier of the modal to open. `destroyModal` opens Aura’s built-in delete confirmation.

route.description: URL the modal submits to; `{key}` placeholders are filled from the row.

content.description: Nested column config rendering the trigger — any column type.

icon.description: Icon-trigger shorthand: a key into the host app’s `icons` config registry. Normalised into `content`.

variant.description: Key into the host app’s `variants` config registry, or a Bootstrap colour name. CSS colour syntax is rejected here.

button.description: Button-trigger shorthand: the button variant. Normalised into `content`.

target.description: Anchor `target` attribute for a link trigger.

cellRules.description: Conditional styling for the `<td>` around the trigger.

key.description: Item field the `if` conditions read, and the field substituted into `{key}` placeholders in `route`. Defaults to the column key.

else.description: Config merged in when no `if` branch matched.

progressBar.description: One segment of a stacked progress bar.

field.description: Item field holding this segment’s value.

progressConfig.description: Bootstrap progress bar. The value comes from `field` or `value` and is scaled against `min` / `max`; the bar colour comes from `variant`, a value `mapping`, or a `thresholds` range table. With `stacked` the `bars` array renders several segments in one track.

field.description: Item field holding the numeric value.

value.description: Fixed numeric value, used instead of `field`.

max.description: Upper bound of the scale: a number, or the name of the item field holding it. Defaults to 100.

min.description: Lower bound of the scale. Defaults to 0.

label.description: Bar label: `true` for the value itself, or fixed text.

labelPosition.description: Render the label inside the bar or next to it.

mapping.description: Value → bar config lookup, keyed by the resolved value.

thresholds.description: Bootstrap colour → `[min, max]` range. The first range containing the value sets the bar colour.

stacked.description: Render the `bars` entries as segments of one track.

showValue.description: Show the raw value in the label.

showPercent.description: Show the percentage in the label.

fields.description: Several item fields, rendered joined by `separator`.

value.description: Fixed text. Takes priority over `fields` and `field`.
